items.title: Colony charter fragment
items.text: ...and no settlement shall be founded beyond the rim stars, nor any ship sent outward, for any reason. Signed only: 'the First Watch'.

items.title: A child's teaching slate
items.text: 'We came from the stars, so we must never look back at them.' The second line has been scratched out by hand, over and over.

items.title: Sealed bulkhead
items.text: A door inscribed in a script older than any human archive. Half of its letters are the same as our own alphabet.

items.title: Observation record 4,112
items.text: Light-script on a crystal pane: 'The newcomers arrived in a fleet of sleeping ships. They asked us to forget we had seen them. We agreed. We should not have.'

items.title: Silpon's axiom
items.text: 'Every silence is a record of something someone chose not to say.' A founding maxim of Noeti science, carved into the threshold.

items.title: Star catalogue
items.text: A catalogue of every star to the galaxy's rim, and one entry beyond it: unnamed, marked only 'origin of the sleepers'.

items.title: Ancient ledger page
items.text: Sold to the newcomers: water, seed stock, silence. Price for the last item: to be paid in full, later.

items.title: Maxim 1
items.text: 'Everything has a price, including the truth. Especially the truth.' Etched above the door of a ruined trade house.

items.title: Customs seal
items.text: A seal stamped on cargo of unknown origin: 'manifest withheld at buyer's request'. The buyer's mark is a human handprint.

items.title: War-song fragment
items.text: 'When the sky-killers come they do not burn the world. They close it, door by door, until no one can leave.'

items.title: Clan oath stone
items.text: 'We swore to stand against the silent ships. The silent ships never came. We swore again, for our children.'

items.title: Broken blade
items.text: A ceremonial blade of an alloy no Varkesh forge can make. The grip was shaped for a human hand.

items.title: Resonance shell
items.text: The shell hums when held. Translated, the hum is one phrase repeated in a thousand voices: 'Someone far away is calling its children.'

items.title: Choir memory
items.text: 'Before the first choir there was a song from beyond the edge. We have been answering it in our sleep ever since.'

items.title: Empty nest
items.text: Thousands of tiny chambers, every one of them facing the galaxy's rim, as if listening.

items.title: Scripture of the Watch, verse 9
items.text: 'And the Unblinking saw the sleepers fall from the dark, and the dark followed them, patient as stone.'

items.title: A heretic's note
items.text: 'The prophecy is not a curse. It is a warning, and we have been reading it backwards.' Signed with a crossed-out eye.

items.title: Observatory plate
items.text: A star plate recording one point of light at the rim that brightened every century for ten thousand years.

items.title: Growth rings
items.text: A slice of a giant tree. Its rings record a year when every forest on the world stopped growing at once, then went on.

items.title: Lullaby
items.text: 'Sleep, small one. The stars are doors, and every door is open.' The Thuum have sung it for longer than they can count.

items.title: Seed vault
items.text: Seeds from a world the Thuum have never visited, labelled in a human-like script: 'from home, in case'.
